UCLA Men's Basketball Team Secures Close Victory Over Cal State Fullerton

The No. 7 UCLA men's basketball team defeated Cal State Fullerton with a final score of 75-71. Trent Perry was instrumental in rallying the team in the final minutes of the game, which took place at Pauley Pavilion.
